package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var data = Type("Data", func() {
	Attribute("bytes", Bytes)
	Required("bytes")
})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {

		Payload(data, func() {
			Example(map[string]any{"bytes": "hi"})
		})
		Result(data)
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/send")
		})

	})

})
